title: Mamtak-Lib
description: A Minecraft fabric settings UI library
body:
# Mamtak-Lib

A Lib that will be used in my projects

## Features 

• Category-based settings screens

• Switches, sliders, dropdowns, buttons, color pickers, and multi-option selectors

• Disabled controls/categories/full-screen lock state

• Built-in scrolling, wrapping, text trimming, and responsive layout
